title: Explainable Neuro-Fuzzy Prediction for Trustworthy Decision-Making in Maritime
abstract: arXiv:2609.24358v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting when maritime systems require maintenance can be critical, avoiding hazards and costly consequences. To address this problem, this paper proposes an explainable decision-making framework that integrates a neuro-fuzzy prediction model with a two-stage explainable component. The first stage of this component produces feature-attribution explanations, using gradient-based saliency maps, and the second stage extracts local rules using a fuzzy decision tree. The proposed framework is generic and can be integrated into any deep learning-based approach, rendering it explainable. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first fuzzy logic-based framework enabling both feature-level and local rule-based explanations of black box models. This approach aims to foster trustworthiness in decision making through user-understandable machine inferences. translated_title: 面向海事可信决策的可解释神经模糊预测
translated_abstract: 预测海事系统何时需要维护至关重要，可以避免危险和高昂的损失。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种可解释的决策框架，该框架将神经模糊预测模型与两阶段可解释组件相结合。该组件的第一阶段使用基于梯度的显著性图生成特征归因解释，第二阶段使用模糊决策树提取局部规则。所提出的框架具有通用性，可以集成到任何基于深度学习的方法中，使其具备可解释性。据我们所知，这是首个基于模糊逻辑的框架，能够对黑盒模型同时提供特征级解释和基于局部规则的解释。该方法旨在通过用户可理解的机器推理来增强决策的可信度。使用深度残差神经骨干网络的所提框架的性能表现……
tldr: 本文提出了首个基于模糊逻辑的可解释框架，将神经模糊预测模型与两阶段解释组件（梯度显著性图特征归因和模糊决策树局部规则提取）相结合，可嵌入任何深度学习模型，为海事系统维护预测提供可信、可理解的决策支持。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first fuzzy logic-based explainable framework that integrates a neuro-fuzzy prediction model with a two-stage explanation component (gradient-based saliency maps for feature attribution and fuzzy decision trees for local rule extraction), which can be embedded into any deep learning model to provide trustworthy and understandable decision support for maritime maintenance prediction.
